paragraphs.text: Keep the DSH right-sidebar terminal mounted across tab switches so it no longer reloads.
# dsh-terminal-keepalive
Keeps the **right-sidebar terminal** of DeepSeek Harness (DSH) mounted when you switch tabs or sessi
ons, so it no longer reloads / re-flashes / stutters on the way back.
## What it fixes
DSH's official right-sidebar terminal tab type does not declare `keepMounted`, so switching to anoth
er tab (files, browser, …) unmounts the terminal body. Coming back re-creates xterm and re-attaches
the host stream, which replays a full screen snapshot — the "reload + lag" you see with `claude code
`, `codebuddy` and other full-screen TUIs.
This plugin flips that flag at runtime for the configured tab kinds (default: the `terminal` tab typ
e) registered in the `sidebarRightTabs` registry. The shell process, output stream and xterm instanc
e then survive tab/session switches; switching becomes a plain show/hide.

- No second PTY, no custom xterm, no change to `app.asar`.
- Keeps the official terminal implementat

ion (official PTY, transport, theme, Agent terminal tools).
- No external runtime dependency to inst
all; the optional WebGL renderer ships `@xterm/addon-webgl` as a bundled chunk (`client.webgl.js`).

## Configuration
### Settings page
Open **Settings → 终端常驻** — its own left-nav entry, not the plugin detail page (0.6.1 removed the dup
licate card there). It is the single place with every option (tab kinds, `maxOpenTabs`, `scrollback`
, `smoothScrollDuration`, and the experimental WebGL renderer `webgl` / `maxWebgl` / `webglVisibleOn
ly`), plus a live WebGL status line (`supported / attached / cap`) and a **保存** (apply immediately,
no restart) / **恢复默认** (reset) button.
**Manually:** the config is a JSON object in `localStorage` under the key **`dsh-terminal-keepalive.
config`**; the plugin writes a default on first run, so you can just edit it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `kinds` | `["terminal"]` | Tab kinds to keep mounted. Known kinds shipped by DSH: `terminal`, `fil

es`, `text`, `browser`, `guide`. An empty list keeps nothing mounted (plugin effectively off). |
| `
maxOpenTabs` | `6` | Memory gate: while the number of open tabs of `kinds` (across all sessions) is
≤ this, they stay mounted; above it, keep-alive turns **off for all of `kinds`** until the count dro

ps back. `0` disables the gate (always keep-mounted). |
| `scrollback` | `null` | Client-side xterm
buffer cap. `null`/empty keeps whatever DSH chose (default `1000`); a positive number overrides it p
er running terminal. Lower values cut repaint/memory on switch-back and scrolling, at the cost of sh

orter in-browser history. |
| `smoothScrollDuration` | `110` | Scroll animation length in ms. The de
fault `110` animates wheel scrolling for a smoother, VSCode-like feel; `0` disables it (xterm's inst

ant jump). |
| `webgl` | `true` | `true` swaps each running terminal's DOM renderer for the GPU (Web
GL) renderer (vendored `@xterm/addon-webgl`). This is the only real fix for the per-frame DOM redraw
cost behind unsmooth scrolling. On by default (guarded by a WebGL2 precheck); auto-falls back to DO
M on context loss / no GPU / load failure, soft-capped at ≥8 contexts (see `maxWebgl`). Applies live

— enabling loads the renderer chunk immediately. Set `false` to opt out. |
[该节后续省略]
## How it works
The DSH right-sidebar tab registry stores each tab type's definition object. `keepMounted` is read f
rom that object when the dock decides whether to keep a tab body mounted.
`client.js` (a client-side Cordis plugin) obtains the `sidebarRightTabs` service and:
1. wraps `register` **once** (idempotent, marked on the service object so HMR never stacks wrappers)

, forcing `keepMounted` on every type listed in `kinds` **before** the registry caches it;
2. forces

already-registered definitions through `get(kind)` on apply;
3. re-runs on registry `subscribe` eve

nts (event-driven, no polling);
4. subscribes to `sidebarRight.openTabs` and reconciles the memory g

ate whenever the open-tab set changes;
5. emits one `console.warn` after 3s if a configured kind nev

er appears, so a DSH API change fails loudly instead of silently;
6. registers the **Settings → 终端常驻
** page (via `settings.section` + a nav icon) and re-applies the config immediately on save/reset/im
port (`requestReconcile` → `reconcile`).
Turning keep-alive off (gate) sets `keepMounted = false` and calls the registry's `refresh()` so alr
eady-rendered tabs re-read the flag and release their bodies; turning it back on restores `true`. On
plugin unload every definition is put back the way its own plugin registered it.

| newer | not yet verified — see the regression checklist

| newer | not yet verified — see the regression checklist below |
It relies on the client service `sidebarRightTabs` (`register`, `get`, `subscribe`, `refresh`) and t
he tab definition field `keepMounted`, plus the optional `sidebarRight.openTabs` snapshot for the me
mory gate; a future DSH release that changes these may require an update. If `sidebarRight.openTabs`
is absent the gate stays open and keep-alive still works.
## Regression checklist (after a DSH upgrade)
1. Open a terminal, run `claude` / `codebuddy`, switch to Files/Browser and back → no white flash, n

o reload, history and process intact, input works.
2. Open two terminals and switch between them.
3.

Switch session and back.
4. Open and close a terminal normally.
5. DevTools console: no `[dsh-termi

nal-keepalive]` warnings.
6. If **`webgl`** is enabled: the console logs `[dsh-terminal-keepalive] W
ebGL renderer active` once, `__dshTerminalKeepalive.webglStatus()` reports `supported: true` with `a

ttached` ≥ 1 and the expected `cap`, and there are no repeated WebGL warnings.
